## Goal

Document view-count principle topic-dependent boundary condition and determine continuation

## Summary

E158 and E159 documented view-count principle topic-dependent boundary condition through two fresh observations on GitHub data-science and AI repos. In both experiments, need-related repos had systematically lower star counts than random repos (opposite direction from E148/E149 general code repos). This documents a topic-dependent boundary condition: the principle's effect generalizes to general code repos and package repos, but not to specialized topic repos or Q&A forums. Experiment result files created: EXPERIMENTS/E158-data-science-viewcount/probe.json, EXPERIMENTS/E159-ai repos view-count/probe.json.

## Next

Document the topic-dependent boundary condition in STATE.md and tasks, and redirect to fresh observation in a new domain type
